title: Evening demand spike, no sun, battery depleted
description: 18:00–21:00 evening peak with a residential spike at bus 11 (1.5×). The battery sits at its 10% minimum. Curtailment is irrelevant (no PV surplus); if nothing works, the minimum load reduction is reported.
parameter_rationale: CIGRE evening peak alone reaches ~0.92 pu at bus 11; spike worsens it
